existing_data: Six structures; 78 exact-string numerical cells from Tables9-10, retained unchanged in the parent published_case package
new_data: Six original transcribed decimal strings from Table11 Achievable fmax per domain, linked by CLKA-CLKF mapping in the table note
budget_atlas: Partition the exact printed-decimal reference problem over nonnegative resource caps at six source counts and frequency requirements at 18 unique lower/mean/upper source frequencies. Include equality faces and one rational representative per open band. Test engine agreement at these representatives, not all arbitrarily close decimal inputs. No sample-frequency distribution or probability is assumed.
precision_scenario: If each displayed range endpoint was rounded to nearest 0.001 MHz, enclose its unknown pre-rounding value by printed value plus/minus 0.0005 MHz. Ties are conservatively included on both sides; the displayed mean remains the central summary. This is a reporting-precision sensitivity assumption, not additional run variability or a confidence interval.
context_diagnostic: Compare descriptive ordering of Table10 standalone three-run means versus Table11 merged-project worst-case summaries. Keep contexts and summary statistics distinct; do not pool timing with standalone resource counts, infer paired trial effects, or produce significance tests.
validation: Independent Fraction-based direct-MHz ordering/feasibility versus reciprocal cost adapter at 3192 representatives; old 72 scenarios retained; exact printed boundaries and selected rational neighbors/precision scenarios tested. Binary64 may collapse distinct nearby decimals, so finite checks do not prove continuum-wide exactness. Mean/std/individual runs are not reconstructed.
limitations: Published numerical summaries and post-layout static timing estimates, not new hardware measurements
Three-run minima/maxima have no prospective or simultaneous coverage guarantee
No protection-equivalence claim, radiation inference, raw-run reconstruction or usability estimate
Exact rational reference values describe printed decimals; core outputs remain binary64
Context rank reversals compare different summaries and implementations and are not causal estimates

Binary64 output can collapse distinct arbitrarily close decimal inputs, including near source thresholds; atlas coverage is an exact-reference statement and engine agreement is tested at finite representatives.
precision_row_interpretation: The 24 changed design/region rows enumerate point and open faces, not probability or area-weighted prevalence. Displayed means are held fixed; no nominal mean-rounding robustness claim.
